theorems.name: Submission.imc_mlb_exists_hasCompactSupport_eLpNorm_sub_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (ν : Measure (Eucl N)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (f : Eucl N → E), MemLp f 1 ν → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, ε ≠ 0 → ∃ g : Eucl N → E, HasCompactSupport g ∧ eLpNorm (f - g) 1 ν ≤ ε ∧ Continuous g ∧ MemLp g 1 ν
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
